messages:
ben: Partner asked for a short playbook: OTLP collector for our HW marketplace appliance, air-gapped friendly. They want cert rotation, minimal collector config, and sample dashboard queries. Can we scope a deliverable?

rhea: Yes. Deliverables: README for cert rotation (offline CSR flow), a rotate.sh script, a minimal collector.yaml (file exporter + commented datadog exporter), and two dashboard tiles. Also include PII redaction guidance.

carter: I'll draft rotate.sh. Plan: verify CSR, sign with offline CA, scp/copy cert to /etc/telemetry/certs/, checksum, then SIGHUP collector. Include --dry-run and a rollback flag. Suggest default cert TTL 90 days.

emily: For collector.yaml snippet: keep traces disabled by default via telemetry.enable_traces=false. Resource attrs: hw.vendor, hw.model, hw.gpu_count. File exporter path /var/log/telemetry/otlp-out.json. Add processor to drop Authorization header.

dd-integ-bot: Datadog partner notes: add tag mapping (model, hw_pool), span prefixes (market.inference.request), and mark traces opt-in for private bundles. Internal guide updated: https://internal.datadog/partners/ri-airgap-patterns

ben: Legal wants two lines for the marketplace listing about telemetry: 1) metrics shipped by default (no PII), 2) traces are opt-in and require consent. Add sample wording in README.

rhea: I'll combine the pieces into a short README and a marketplace docs snippet. Carter + I will run a rotate smoke test Wed 10:00 PT on sim-hw and post logs.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Simulation job queued: sim/rotate-test-45. Logs at https://ci.redwood/run/45/logs once complete.

carter: Sounds good. I'll push rotate.sh to infra-extras and link the PR here after the run.

emily: I'll create the dashboard tile JSON and include example queries for token_rate and kv_hit_ratio. Tag them partner:datadog, market:hardware, privacy:airgap-friendly.

ben: Great. Timeline: README + sample config (rhea/emily) by EOD Tue, rotate script + test (carter) Wed AM. Legal to supply final wording. Keep updates in this thread.
